description: This file provides PHP functions for sending emails within the vtiger CRM system, including configuring SMTP, attaching files, handling signatures, and managing email errors.

methods.name: send_mail
methods.description: Main function to compose and send an email using SMTP configuration, with options for attachments, signatures, and handling BCC/CC.

methods.name: getUserEmailId
methods.description: Retrieves the email of a user from the vtiger_users table based on a specified column and value.

methods.name: addSignature
methods.description: Appends the user's signature to the email contents.

methods.name: setMailerProperties
methods.description: Configures the properties of the PHPMailer object, such as subject, body, sender info, and attachments.

methods.name: setMailServerProperties
methods.description: Sets the SMTP server details for the mailer from the vtiger_systems database table.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Attaches a specific file to the email.

methods.name: addAllAttachments
methods.description: Attaches all files linked to a particular record in vtiger to the email.

methods.name: setCCAddress
methods.description: Adds CC or BCC email addresses to the mail.

methods.name: MailSend
methods.description: Sends the email via PHPMailer and returns the status.

methods.name: getMailError
methods.description: Retrieves error information if email sending fails.

methods.name: getParentMailId
methods.description: Fetches the email ID of the parent contact or account record.

methods.name: getMailErrorString
methods.description: Parses a string of email errors into an encoded error message.

methods.name: parseEmailErrorString
methods.description: Decodes and interprets email error strings into human-readable messages.

methods.name: isUserInitiated
methods.description: Checks if the email was initiated by a user action.

methods.name: getDefaultAssigneeEmailIds
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses for all users within a specific group.
